text: Records traces of what agents did in production, used for debugging failures, monitoring quality, and building eval datasets
quote: Traces are the record of what your agents did in production. Use them to debug failures, monitor quality, and build the datasets you evaluate against.

text: Filter, export, share, and compare traces through the UI or the API
quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.

text: Automate workflows using rules, webhooks, and online evaluations
quote: Automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations.

text: Annotate outputs and collect user feedback through annotation queues or inline annotation
quote: Annotate outputs and gather user feedback using queues or inline annotation.

text: LangSmith Engine automatically detects recurring issues in traces, diagnoses root causes, and helps resolve them
quote: Automatically detect recurring issues in your traces, diagnose their root cause, and resolve them with LangSmith Engine.

text: Build datasets from curated test cases, historical production traces, or synthetic data generation
quote: Create a dataset with examples from manually curated test cases, historical production traces, or synthetic data generation.

text: Add real production traces to a dataset so a one-off failure becomes a repeatable test
quote: Add real traces to a dataset so a failure you saw once becomes a test you run every time.

text: Score performance with evaluators: human review, code rules, LLM-as-judge, and pairwise comparison
quote: Create evaluators to score performance: Human review, Code rules, LLM-as-judge, Pairwise comparison

text: Run the app over a dataset as an experiment, with configurable repetitions, concurrency, and caching
quote: Execute your application on the dataset to create an experiment. Configure repetitions, concurrency, and caching to optimize runs.

text: Run evaluations on curated datasets during development to compare versions, benchmark performance, and catch regressions
quote: Run evaluations on curated datasets during development to compare versions, benchmark performance, and catch regressions.

text: Run evaluators automatically on production traces (safety, format, quality, reference-free LLM-as-judge), with filters and sampling rates
quote: Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces: safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics, and reference-free LLM-as-judge. Apply filters and sampling rates to control costs.

text: Accept traces from any OpenTelemetry-compatible application
quote: LangSmith supports OpenTelemetry-based tracing, allowing you to send traces from any OpenTelemetry-compatible application.

text: Route traces through an OpenTelemetry Collector that batches them and fans them out to multiple destinations
quote: an OpenTelemetry Collector, which batches and routes them to one or more destinations simultaneously (fanout).

text: Threshold-based alerts on run count, cost, errors, feedback score, and latency
quote: LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency

text: Send alerts to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any HTTP endpoint via webhook
quote: Alerts can route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any HTTP endpoint via webhook.

text: Narrow error and latency alerts with a filter builder that stacks conditions on status, run type, tag, and error
quote: for Errors and Latency, you can use the filter builder to stack conditions on fields such as Status, Run Type, Tag, and Error.

text: Alerts can surface critical issues such as API rate limit violations from model providers
quote: LangSmith’s alerts feature helps identify critical issues such as: API rate limit violations from model providers.

text: Prebuilt per-project dashboards are created automatically, covering trace count, error rates, token usage, and more
quote: Prebuilt dashboards are created automatically for each project and cover essential metrics, such as trace count, error rates, token usage, and more.

text: Build custom dashboards from configurable collections of charts for the metrics that matter to you
quote: Create tailored collections of charts for tracking metrics that matter most for your application.

text: Group dashboard data by run tag or metadata to split metrics across application-specific attributes
quote: You can use group by run tag or metadata to split data over attributes that are important to your application.

text: Self-host LangSmith in your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering
quote: Host an instance of LangSmith in your own infrastructure for [observability](/langsmith/observability), [evaluation](/langsmith/evaluation), and [prompt engineering](/langsmith/prompt-context-hub#prompts).

text: Self-hosted deployments keep trace and operational data inside your own environment
quote: Self-hosted LangSmith runs the LangSmith platform in your own infrastructure so that trace and operational data stay in your environment.

text: Optionally enable LangSmith Deployment to deploy and manage agents from the LangSmith UI
quote: Host an instance of LangSmith in your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering. You can optionally enable LangSmith Deployment to deploy and manage agents through the LangSmith UI.

text: Tune Agent Server for self-hosted deployments, with example Helm configurations for different read and write load patterns
quote: Tune the Agent Server for self-hosted deployments—write load, read load, and example Helm configurations for different load patterns.

text: Wrap the OpenAI client to trace its calls automatically
quote: client = wrap_openai(openai.Client())

text: Official SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java to trace any agent stack
quote: Trace your preferred framework or integrate LangSmith with any agent stack using our Python, Typescript, Go, or Java SDKs.

text: Integrations with OpenAI, Anthropic, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, Pydantic AI, and more
quote: Browse available integrations to connect your stack including OpenAI, Anthropic, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, Pydantic AI, and more.

text: Works with any LLM application and natively integrates with the LangChain Python and JS libraries
quote: It works with any LLM Application, including a native integration with the LangChain Python and LangChain JS open source libraries.

text: Add tracing quickly using environment variables, framework integrations, or the SDK
quote: Add tracing to your app in minutes with environment variables, framework integrations, or the SDK.

text: A gateway traces every call itself, so no tracing setup is needed in your code
quote: the gateway traces every call itself, with no tracing setup in your code.

text: Inspect threads and runs in Messages, Turns, and Details views
quote: Inspect threads and runs in the Messages, Turns, and Details views.

text: Unify traces when another service calls a deployed Agent Server via RemoteGraph or the SDK
quote: Unify traces when calling your deployed Agent Server from another service using RemoteGraph or the SDK.

text: Agent Auth gives agents secure access to external systems using OAuth 2.0 credentials
quote: Enable secure access from agents to any system using OAuth 2.0 credentials with Agent Auth.

text: Playground forwards requests to various LLM APIs and can connect to your own custom model servers
quote: The Playground is a service that handles forwarding requests to various LLM APIs... This can also be used to connect to your own custom model servers.

text: Free tier includes up to 5k base traces per month, then pay-as-you-go
quote: Up to 5k base traces / mo, then pay-as-you-go
